insights: Mathlib Dynamics.Ergodic provides full Poincaré recurrence via Conservative.exists_gt_measure_inter_ne_zero
The chain MeasurePreserving → Conservative → Poincaré is complete in Mathlib with zero additional axioms
MeasurePreserving.iterate gives T^[n] iteration; preimage T^[n] ⁻¹ B with measure preservation
IsProbabilityMeasure → IsFiniteMeasure → MeasurePreserving.conservative is the key inference
Furstenberg correspondence construction (~500 lines) needs: product spaces, Cesàro averages, weak-* compactness
Multiple recurrence k≥3 (~2000+ lines) needs: ergodic decomposition, compact extensions, structure theory
The k=2 case of Szemerédi follows from correspondence + Poincaré with only 1 axiom
Full Szemerédi via Furstenberg needs exactly 2 axioms (correspondence + k≥3 recurrence)
